'''Ord Gimmel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the same path as [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], acting as a [[Merchant/Legends|trade hub]] and [[Factory world/Legends|manufacturing center]]. However, it was also war-torn, with its [[Queen/Legends|queen]] having mysteriously disappeared in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] was [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] over [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this was one of the planets on which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was stationed.

Ord Gimmel's food rations were mostly imported from the planet [[Parada]] from the [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]], including [[womback]]'s meat and different variety of [[Grain/Legends|grains]].

==History==
===Early history===
Ord Gimmel was discovered by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] military scouts over ten thousand years before the Battle of Yavin. The discovery was classified by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and the planet's covert colonization was used to support the [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade|Twelfth]] and [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]]s. After the end of the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], Ord Gimmel and its inhabitants were left forgotten.<ref name="SoR" />

Forced to fend for themselves, the native [[Deaon/Legends|Deaons]] of Ord Gimmel supported a royal bloodline of rulers that were descended from Grand Vicar [[Sidharra]], the spiritual leader of the [[cathedral ship]] that had first settled Ord Gimmel. Over time, the Deaons abandoned the practices of the [[Pius Dea]], although there were still vestigial influences in Deaon colloquialisms and architecture.<ref name="SoR" />

===Rediscovery===
Around [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]], Ord Gimmel was rediscovered by the Republic. The ruling [[Queen/Legends|queen]] at the time, [[Welnarra]], quickly sought to reintegrate Ord Gimmel with the galaxy and signed key manufacturing agreements with offworld interests. This resulted in unprecedented growth for Ord Gimmel, and by the final centuries of the Republic the planet had become the top [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] component manufacturer in the region.<ref name="SoR" />

At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Queen [[Nehanna]] declared her support for the Republic and voided all contracts that Ord Gimmel had with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] shipbuilders.<ref name="SoR" />
